- **#4419** comes from Moss's undated North cheat sheet. It describes barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, sent to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

Moss's other four notes have no Quarrendon ticket numbers.

I also warned Dana that Marcus's own 14 Jul 2025 note lists #4419 as a Gate 3 printer lag issue, which doesn't match Moss's description. Dana should check the ticket before #4419 goes into the weekly notes.
